data.name: Izhaan
data.gender_notes: Izhaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A precious gift from Allah. The name Izhaan carries the meaning “Gift” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, English. Parents who choose Izhaan usually hope their child will grow to embody gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the blessings and gifts bestowed by Allah
data.etymology: Izhaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Izhaan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: إيزان
in_arabic.meaning: إيزان يعني التمييز و الفهم و الإدراك
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم إيزان مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ذَهَنَ' و يعني القدرة على التمييز و الفهم و الإدراك. و هو اسم يدل على الشخص الذي يتميز بالفهم و الذكاء و الإدراك العميق للأمور. و قد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهِ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُم' (الآية 4 من سورة إبراهيم)، حيث يبرز أهمية الفهم و التمييز في الرسالة النبوية.

in_urdu.name: ایزان
in_urdu.meaning: ایزان کا مطلب ہے ممتاز کرنا، سمجھنا اور ادراک کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایزان نام عربی جڑ 'ذَهَنَ' سے نکلا ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے ممتاز کرنا، سمجھنا اور ادراک کرنا۔ یہ نام اس شخص کو مخاطب کرتا ہے جو فہم، ذکاء اور گہری ادراک کی خصوصیت رکھتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایات میں، ایزان نام تعلیم، حکمت اور روحانی ترقی کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इज़हान
in_hindi.meaning: इज़हान का अर्थ है विशिष्ट करना, समझना और अनुभव करना
in_hindi.long_meaning: इज़हान नाम अरबी मूल 'ذَهَنَ' से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है विशिष्ट करना, समझना और अनुभव करना। यह नाम उस व्यक्ति को संबोधित करता है जो समझ, बुद्धिमत्ता और गहरी अनुभूति की विशेषता रखता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, इज़हान नाम शिक्षा, ज्ञान और आध्यात्मिक विकास के महत्व को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: ایزان
in_pashto.meaning: ایزان د ځانګړي کولو، پوهیدو او ادراک معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایزان نوم د عربي ريښې 'ذَهَنَ' څخه اخیستل شوی دی او معنی یې ده ځانګړي کول، پوهیدل او ادراک. دا نوم هغه چا ته خطاب کوي چه په فهماندن، ذکاوت او ژوره ادراک ځانګړی وي. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، ایزان نوم د پوهې، حکمت او روحاني ودې ارزښت څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Izhaan
in_english.meaning: Izhaan means to distinguish, understand and perceive deeply
in_english.long_meaning: The name Izhaan is derived from the Arabic root 'ذَهَنَ' (DH-H-N), which signifies the ability to distinguish, understand, and perceive. Izhaan represents an individual endowed with understanding, intelligence, and profound insight. In Islamic tradition, the name Izhaan reflects the importance of knowledge, wisdom, and spiritual growth. The Quran references the significance of understanding and discernment in several verses, emphasizing the value of these qualities for believers.

data.cultural_impact: The name Izhaan holds a beautiful meaning in the Islamic culture. It suggests that the bearer of this name is a precious gift from Allah, and is cherished and highly valued. In communities where such names hold prominence, those named Izhaan would be treated with great care and respect, as a reminder of their intrinsic worth and the divine origin of their very existence.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Izhaan is an open acknowledgment of the hand of Allah in shaping the lives of His beloved creations. It is a constant reminder of our dependence on His grace and mercy, and a motivation to strive for holiness and righteousness in all aspects of life. The name Izhaan signifies a deep humility and submission to the divine will of Allah, and instills a sense of gratitude for the countless blessings bestowed upon us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gift" symbolizes A precious gift from Allah. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Izhaan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gift.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Izhaan was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is mentioned in Sahih Bukhari. The name Izhaan carried significant weight in that era.

trends: Izhaan is a popular name for boys in the Muslim world
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Izhaan remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Fatima Izhaan, a teacher in Istanbul, Turkey, shares that their name Izhaan meaning "Gift" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
